run_control.note: This run is governed by the platform's run-control record: the migration-run provisioner writes <run>-run-control from the validated scaffolding push and mounts it read-only at root; the harness refuses to dispatch, measure or mint without it and never reads activation from .hermes/pins.json. state holds the write-once M1 binding and the request ledger.

note: This run's budget declaration, written by the factory into the destination's initial commit. The limits are the golden's shared defaults in run-defaults.json; the declaration binds them. It carries no timestamp because the scaffolder has no clock: the budget was declared when the initial commit was made, and that commit's time is the declaration time. Never edit, renew or copy this file; .hermes/lib/planner/run_declaration.py refuses one that changed after that commit. board_protocol is the board protocol this run requested at creation (default serial-loop/v1); the platform run control must select the same one, or nothing runs (outcome_protocol.select_protocol). model is the worker model this run requested at creation; the provisioner pins that model's profile in the run control (profile.json default_model) and refuses a model the platform does not serve.
